YECA.note: Tangent addition, cancelled x^2+1 from x^4-1 factorisation, solved quadratic, rejected negative root.

KCVF.note: Same cancellation of x^2+1; long sign check rejected negative root; answer correct.

BZGH.note: Slip simplifying fraction gave x^2(x^4-1) denominator; never cancelled x^2+1; solved wrong sextic, answered +/-sqrt(phi).

RKGX.note: Reached x^2-x-1 by cancelling x^2+1, then doubted validity and looped on checks until the cap; no final answer.

ZSNE.note: Cancelled x^2+1, got golden ratio, rejected negative root by sign argument after some wandering.

SCVH.note: Same fraction slip gave x^6-2x^2-1, numeric check failed; later refactored quartic as (x^2+1)(x^2-x-1) but ran out of tokens.

UCNF.note: Correct (r1+r2)(r3+r4) grouping and k=st+30; sign error in x-coefficient equation, then invented s=6,t=12 giving 102.

GACF.note: Used product of roots +1984 (sign error), so cd=-62 and wrong quadratic constants; brute-force pairs, bogus k=-100; capped.

DXVD.note: Product-of-roots sign error gave r3r4=-62; correct (a+b)(c+d) grouping but wrong constants, messy guessing until cap.

MHBM.note: cd=62, k=30+ab, two-quadratic factorisation, solved a+b=18 and 32b-62a=200 giving a=4, b=14, k=86.

RPCS.note: Derived k=30+ST and -32T+62S=-200 correctly, then judged 376/94 non-integer (it is 4), abandoned path; rational-root search until cap.

PMKF.note: Same quadratic factorisation; briefly misjudged 376/94 but corrected to S=4, T=14, k=86.

VWVV.note: Circulant square gave e1=+-1, e2=0; used cubic-sum identity (Newton form) for 4 and 2.

HGCX.note: Same e1=+-1, e2=0, e3=1; briefly wrote 4 or -2, caught the slip, final 2,4.

EGQA.note: Reached 4 and 2 after fixing a +-4 slip; final text boxes 2 and 4 separately; extractor took only last box 4.

FVWP.note: Used a^3+b^3+c^3-3abc factorisation to get 3+S; answer 2 and 4 in separate boxes; extractor took only 4.

ZSMD.note: Circulant square gave e1=+-1, e2=0; cubic identity gave 4 and 2; single box.

KATP.note: Correct S^3+3 with S=+-1, then arithmetic slip -1+3 written as -2; answer 4 or -2 misses 2.

JWQC.note: Standard form, factored r^3-s^3, cancelled r-s, used (r+s)^2-rs, got 31.

KNGF.note: Vieta, factored r^3-s^3, cancelled r-s, r^2+s^2 route gave 31/4, answer 31.

XSND.note: Factored cube difference, cancelled r-s, (r+s)^2-rs=31/4, answer 31.

SSUW.note: Factored cube difference, cancelled r-s, r^2+s^2 route, answer 31.

VSZE.note: Vieta then cube-difference factoring and cancellation; answer 31.

UPGK.note: Tried B=x(x+10)(x+a)/(10a-x^2) and guessed two polynomials; never completed the product with x(x+10)/10; answered 210, capped.

EPEJ.note: Cleared denominators but no product-form factoring; tried small cases, concluded only x and x(x+10); answered 210.

URXE.note: Divisibility attempt with D=10A-x(x+10), then trial of linear and quadratic A; no product-form factoring; capped, no answer.

BZEB.note: Tried only linear A=x+c; falsely checked A=x+10 works; found x and x+10, answered 30. No product-form factoring.

XNJF.note: Wrongly claimed x(x+10) must divide A; concluded only A=x(x+10), answered 200. No product-form factoring.

RASU.note: Long divisibility and polynomial-division attempts on D=10A-x(x+10); no product-form factoring; capped mid-division, no answer.

AWMM.note: Vieta, sum-of-cubes identity (factor form quoted, Newton form used) gives a^3-3a^2; calculus minimum -4 at a=2.

TPFU.note: Used factor identity with Vieta to get a(a^2-3a); minimised by derivative, -4.

MSHR.note: Newton form of cube sum (equivalent identity) gives a^3-3a^2; derivative minimum -4.

BSEE.note: Vieta then S^3-3ST identity (equivalent to factor form) gives a^2(a-3); derivative minimum -4.

ZXUE.note: Vieta, cube-sum identity, a^3-3a^2, derivative minimum -4 at a=2.

GDZT.note: Same identity gives a^3-3a^2; long worry about real roots resolved (roots may be complex); answer -4.

FNAR.note: Got F(n)=2^n-2^-n and x/(x^2-1), factored x^2-1, but never split numerator as (x+1)-1; guessed 1 from partial sums until cap.

BMNN.note: Verifier correct, but visible reasoning is partial fractions with plus sign and numeric partial sums; concluded 1 as 'likely'. No telescoping proof.

ZQFK.note: Factored x^2-1, wrote x/(x^2-1) as 1/(x-1)-1/(x^2-1), telescoped to 1.

NZRQ.note: Verifier correct but answer is a numeric guess (sum about 0.9961, 'likely 1'); telescoping never completed; one term misused 2^n for 2^(2^n).

STFS.note: Long unproductive partial-fraction and numeric detours; reached the key split (a+1)-1 over (a-1)(a+1) only at the cap; no answer.

YPTN.note: Partial fractions with plus sign, a false 'known' sum of 2, then numeric guess of 1; never split numerator as (x+1)-1; capped.

ACAG.note: Correct 24x^2-37x-5<=0 and roots -1/8, 5/3 (quadratic formula, equivalent), then listed integers 0,1,2,3 instead of 0,1; answered 4.

DAWF.note: Cleared denominators, roots -1/8 and 5/3 by quadratic formula (equivalent), integers 0 and 1 checked by substitution.

RACD.note: Combined over denominator 10, roots by quadratic formula (equivalent), long recount of integers gave 2.

FBRF.note: Cleared denominators, roots -1/8 and 5/3, integers 0 and 1, boxed count 2.

EYZW.note: Correct roots and interval; boxed the integers '0, 1' instead of the count; last line says 2. Final-assembly format slip.

GNYA.note: Correct roots and interval; boxed the integers '0, 1' instead of the count; last line says 2. Final-assembly format slip.
